sample_unit: LLM responses (10 questions x 2 languages x 3 LLMs)

links.outcome: Clinical reliability scores of LLM THA patient education responses, English vs Spanish
links.effect: Significant main effect of language (p = 0.014, η2 = 0.151); lower clinical reliability scores for Spanish responses in all 3 LLMs; within-model declines nonsignificant.
links.quote: A statistically significant main effect of language was found (p = 0.014, η2 = 0.151), indicating significantly lower clinical reliability scores for Spanish responses in all LLMs.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of three LLMs providing patient education responses in English vs. Spanish, evaluated by clinicians for reliability/equity without testing an intervention or guardrail.
